findings.title: Payment Terms
findings.deviation: Payment within 60 days after the date of timesheet approval. AtliQ playbook requires payment within 30 days of receipt of invoice, with a maximum of 45 days.
findings.impact: Longer payment terms can strain AtliQ's cash flow and may lead to disputes.
findings.clauseRef: 4.3: Payment shall be made within sixty (60) days after the date of timesheet approval.
findings.quote: Payment within 30 days of receipt of invoice (45 days maximum); no pay-when-paid; set-off limited to undisputed amounts under this agreement. Counter: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs; mutual notice period.
findings.counterPosition: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs; mutual notice period.
findings.linkedClauseRef: 4.2: The Company's project manager shall review and approve timesheets at his discretion.
findings.linkedQuote: Invoices payable within 30 days of receipt; 45 days is the negotiated maximum.

findings.title: Termination for Convenience
findings.deviation: The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving twenty-four (24) hours' written notice (including by email) to the Contractor. AtliQ playbook requires mutual notice periods.
findings.impact: Unfair to the contractor and may lead to disputes.
findings.clauseRef: 9.1: The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving twenty-four (24) hours' written notice (including by email) to the Contractor.
findings.quote: On any termination for convenience AtliQ is paid for all work done, including work in progress. Notice is mutual. Client contracts: reasonable notice (typically 30+ days). Freelancer / vendor agreements: a mutual short exit (about 15 days, as with Rohan Iyer) is AtliQ's standard and fair to both sides.
findings.counterPosition: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs; mutual notice period.
findings.linkedClauseRef: 9.2: The Contractor may terminate this Agreement by giving sixty (60) days' written notice to the Company.

findings.title: Non-Compete and Non-Solicitation
findings.deviation: For a period of twelve (12) months after termination or expiry, the Contractor shall not, anywhere in the world, directly or indirectly, provide any software or data services to any person, whether as an employee, consultant, contractor, partner or otherwise, in competition with the Company. AtliQ playbook recommends limiting non-competes to named competitors in a defined territory for the term only, with a mutual termination right.
findings.impact: This is overly restrictive and may not be fair to the contractor.
findings.clauseRef: 8.1: For a period of twelve (12) months after termination or expiry, the Contractor shall not, anywhere in the world, directly or indirectly, provide any software or data services to any person, whether as an employee, consultant, contractor, partner or otherwise, in competition with the Company.
findings.quote: Delete, or limit to named competitors in a defined territory for the term only, with a mutual termination right.
findings.counterPosition: Delete or limit to named competitors in a defined territory for the term only, with a mutual termination right.
findings.linkedClauseRef: 8.2: For a period of twelve (12) months after termination or expiry, the Contractor shall not solicit or accept work from any client of the Company for whom he performed Services, or solicit any employee of the Company.
findings.linkedQuote: Delete, or limit to named competitors in a defined territory for the term only, with a mutual termination right.

findings.title: Limitation of Liability
findings.deviation: Each party's aggregate liability capped at 1× fees (paid or payable in the prior 12 months), mutual; carve-outs only for fraud, wilful misconduct and confidentiality (plus any carve-outs that are mandatory under the governing law, e.g. German law for intent/gross negligence and injury). AtliQ playbook requires mutual caps, but does not carve out data protection liability.
findings.impact: This is overly restrictive and may not be fair to the contractor.
findings.clauseRef: 10.2: Each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable under the applicable SOW in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, except for breach of confidentiality, indemnification obligations, or gross negligence or willful misconduct.
findings.quote: Mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct and breach of confidentiality; data-protection liability under a separate super-cap (e.g. 2× fees).
findings.counterPosition: Mutual cap of 1× fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct and breach of confidentiality; data-protection liability under a separate super-cap (e.g. 2× fees).
